text: The Sindh Water and Agriculture Transformation (SWAT) Project is a World Bank-financed initiative by the Government of Sindh, launched in 2023. It aims to enhance agricultural water productivity, strengthen integrated water resources management, and support the recovery of small and medium-sized farmers affected by the 2022 floods. The project involves policy reform, institutional strengthening, canal modernization, and a smart-subsidy scheme to promote water-efficient, high-value crops. It is aligned with Pakistan’s Vision 2025 and the National Water Policy 2018, and guided by the Sindh Strategic Water Plan.
